text:
devin: thinking aloud 1 — what if we add a 'stability buffer' control in the rollout UX. operator picks 0-30s where runtime will tolerate transient spikes before triggering fallback. feedback?

maria: makes sense. need to be explicit about which triggers it applies to (latency only? errors too?). separate toggle for error thresholds.

sam: default 6s. UI should show expected p95 change if you increase buffer. also add 'preview' to simulate a high-latency spike.

devin: i like three degrade flavors: buffer-keep (keep trying), truncate (shorter output), early-fallback (immediate). naming suggestions welcome.
olivia: for runbooks prefer literal names: keep_trying, truncate_output, failfast. easier for oncall.
zack: can we add a 'reason snippet' in the request log so engineers see why a particular call fell back? tiny sentence + link to trace.

ops-bot: rollout: fallback_stability_buffer_v1 enabled for 15% orgs

maria: telemetry fields proposed: trigger_type, chosen_flavor, ms_at_trigger, primary_tokens, fallback_tokens, sampled_output_id. add org-level sampling_rate.
sam: audit policy: sampled raw outputs retained 90d by default; UI replay with redact option; raw outputs gated by RBAC.
devin: console UX: inline pill on traces: "fell back: latency 5.3s  why" -> popover with short explanation + CTA "compare with primary" which opens side-by-side diff.
olivia: add operator 'panic switch' to force failfast across org during incidents. must be gated and auditable.
maria: API change: emit header X-Redwood-Fallback-V2: flavor=keep_trying;trigger=latency;trace=trc_abc when fallback occurs. fallback_meta optional in body when client requests debug=true.
sam: curl example:

    curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# response header: X-Redwood-Fallback-V2: flavor=truncate_output;trigger=error_rate;trace=trc_007

devin: sampling defaults? ops-bot suggests org-default 0.1% sampled traces, cohort in experiment 4%.

ops-bot: set sampling_rate=0.1% / experiment_cohort=4% (tag: stability_buffer_expt)

maria: action items: 1) telemetry schema PR 2) API header + optional body field spec 3) console pill UI + compare flow 4) RBAC for raw outputs 5) panic switch implementation 6) rollout plan + runbook copy.
sam: add unit tests for header presence + UI pill rendering; e2e simulate high-latency.
devin: i'll wire mock and drop screenshot. thanks all.

olivia: 60a"
